import pandas as pd
import glob

files = glob.glob('CHIP_DP10_GQ20_PASS/*.xlsx')
print(f"Number of sample files: {len(files)}")

counts = []
for f in files:
    df = pd.read_excel(f, header=1)
    # Filter In_CHIP == True
    chip = df[df['In_CHIP'] == True]
    # Get sequence ontology
    so = chip['Sequence Ontology (Combined)'].fillna('').astype(str)
    # Filter out intronic, intergenic, UTR
    is_intron = so.str.contains('intron', case=False)
    is_utr = so.str.contains('UTR', case=False)
    is_intergenic = so.str.contains('intergenic', case=False)
    filtered = chip[~(is_intron | is_utr | is_intergenic)]
    counts.append(len(filtered))

avg = sum(counts) / len(counts)
print(f"\nAverage number of CHIP variants per sample after filtering: {avg:.2f}")
print(f"Individual counts (first 10): {counts[:10]}")
print(f"Min: {min(counts)}, Max: {max(counts)}")

# Save answer
with open('/workspace/answer.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"<answer>{avg:.2f}</answer>\n")
print("\nAnswer saved to /workspace/answer.txt")
EOF
